_comment: The issue #137 sweep corpus, pinned. run_sweep.py converts each package with rypip (which resolves the pinned version from PyPI into its cache), builds the generated crate, and records the rustc error histogram. Keep this list small and meaningful: each package adds a full convert+build to every sweep.

packages.name: urllib3
packages.note: The historical #137 corpus. Round 72: compiled-regex statics type as the runtime Regex; .match/.search/.fullmatch dispatch through PyRegexOps (988 -> 978). Sweep at 28efebd (schema 2): 605 coded + 54 other diagnostics (650 at 24d1987; 687 at round 118).

packages.name: certifi
packages.note: Close to a fully-clean package (was ~8 errors); a clean package is a far better regression canary than a 1600-error crate. Sweep at 28efebd (schema 2): 0, builds.

packages.name: idna
packages.note: Round 61: boxed-operand membership on literal lists (64). Sweep at 28efebd (schema 2): 0, builds (44 at round 118; clean since #402).

packages.name: charset_normalizer
packages.note: Round 66: tuple-literal for-iteration (289 -> 285). Issue #332: the dynamic issubclass in utils.py no longer blocks conversion; 121 at that round. Sweep at 28efebd (schema 2): 41 coded + 3 other diagnostics (42 at 24d1987; 47 at round 118). Counter(layer) in cd.py had no construction lowering, so #426's refusal stopped this package converting AT ALL; the Counter construction slice restored it at 39 coded + 3 (run-counter-137).

packages.name: requests
packages.note: The dependent-package frontier (imports urllib3/charset_normalizer/idna/certifi; 112 errors at the round-54 baseline). Round 55: urllib.parse + class registry (69). Round 56: builtin-class values, tuple boxing, compat imports, del reads, range annotations (29). Round 57: module tuple-unpack promotion (25). Sweep at 28efebd (schema 2): 2127 coded + 205 other diagnostics (2249 at 24d1987; 2245 at round 118). pin_dependencies: requests' own specifiers (urllib3<3, charset_normalizer<4, ...) let rypip pick the newest PyPI release, so once urllib3 2.8.0 shipped a fresh cache measured requests against 2.8.0 (which fails conversion) instead of the corpus's 2.0.7; the probe now lists the corpus pins ahead of requests so they win.
